questions.stem: Let f(x) = x³ + ax² + bx − 6. Both x − 1 and x − 2 are factors. (a) Find a and b. (b) Factorise f(x) completely. (c) Solve f(x) = 0.
questions.stemZh: 設 f(x) = x³ + ax² + bx − 6，x − 1 和 x − 2 均為其因式。(a) 求 a、b；(b) 完全分解 f(x)；(c) 解 f(x) = 0。
questions.solution:
(a) f(1)=0 gives a+b=5. f(2)=0 gives 2a+b=−1. Subtraction gives a=−6 and b=11.
(b) f(x)=(x−1)(x−2)(x−3).
(c) x=1, 2 or 3.
questions.hint: Use f(1) = 0 and f(2) = 0 to form two equations in a and b.
questions.hintZh: 由 f(1) = 0 及 f(2) = 0 建立兩條含 a、b 的方程。
rubric: 由兩個因式建立兩條正確方程。（2 分）
完全分解成三個一次因式。（2 分）

questions.stem: Prove that the difference between the squares of any two consecutive integers is odd.
questions.stemZh: 證明任意兩個相鄰整數的平方之差必為奇數。
questions.solution: Let the integers be n and n+1, where n is an integer. (n+1)²−n²=2n+1, which is odd. Reversing the order gives −(2n+1), also odd.
questions.solutionZh: 設兩個整數為 n、n+1。(n+1)²−n²=2n+1，是奇數；若倒轉相減，所得負數亦是奇數。
questions.hint: Write the integers as n and n+1, and expand their difference of squares.
questions.hintZh: 把相鄰整數寫成 n 和 n+1，再展開平方差。
rubric: 以整數 n 表示兩個相鄰整數。
指出 2n+1 為奇數，完成結論。

questions.stem:
(a) Simplify \[\begin{gathered}(5 x^{3}-x^{2}+x-1) \\ -(7 x^{2}+5)\end{gathered}\]
(b) Find the value of the polynomial when \(x=-2\).
questions.stemZh:
(a) 化簡 \[\begin{gathered}(5 x^{3}-x^{2}+x-1) \\ -(7 x^{2}+5)\end{gathered}\]
(b) 當 \(x=-2\) 時，求該多項式的值。
questions.solution:
(a) Expand each product using the distributive law, then collect like terms: \[\begin{gathered}(5 x^{3}-x^{2}+x-1) \\ -(7 x^{2}+5) \\ = 5 x^{3} \\ + (- x^{2}) + x \\ + (-1) \\ + (- 7 x^{2} - 5) \\ = 5 x^{3} - 8 x^{2} \\ + x - 6\end{gathered}\]
(b) Substitute \(x=-2\): \[\begin{gathered}5 x^{3} - 8 x^{2} \\ + x - 6 = -80\end{gathered}\]

questions.stemZh:
(a) 化簡 \[\begin{gathered}(6 a^{2}-5 a b-b^{2}) \\ +(a b-b^{2}) \\ -(7 a b+5 a^{2}-b^{2})\end{gathered}\]
(b) 當 \(a=-1, b=-2\) 時，求該多項式的值。
questions.solution:
(a) Expand each product using the distributive law, then collect like terms: \[\begin{gathered}(6 a^{2}-5 a b-b^{2}) \\ +(a b-b^{2}) \\ -(7 a b+5 a^{2}-b^{2}) \\ = 6 a^{2} \\ + (- 5 a b) \\ + (- b^{2}) + a b \\ + (- b^{2}) \\ + (- 5 a^{2} - 7 a b + b^{2}) \\ = a^{2} - 11 a b \\ - b^{2}\end{gathered}\]
(b) Substitute \(a=-1, b=-2\): \[\begin{gathered}a^{2} - 11 a b \\ - b^{2} = -25\end{gathered}\]

(c) 求 (a) 中展開式的次數。

en.text: (a) Expand each product using the distributive law, then collect like terms: \[\begin{gathered}2 x y^{3} (x-5 y^{2}) \\ +5 x y^{2} (x^{2}+x y+y^{3}) \\ = 2 x^{2} y^{3} \\ - 10 x y^{5} \\ + 5 x^{3} y^{2} \\ + 5 x^{2} y^{3} \\ + 5 x y^{5} \\ = 5 x^{3} y^{2} \\ + 7 x^{2} y^{3} \\ - 5 x y^{5}\end{gathered}\]
(b) Coefficient: \(7\). (c) Total degree: \(6\).

questions.stem:
(a) Expand \[\begin{gathered}(x^{2}-2 x+1) \\ \cdot (x-1)\end{gathered}\]
(b) Find the degree of the expansion in (a).
(c) Find the coefficient of \(x^{2}\) in the expansion in (a).
questions.stemZh:
(a) 展開 \[\begin{gathered}(x^{2}-2 x+1) \\ \cdot (x-1)\end{gathered}\]
(b) 求 (a) 中展開式的次數。
(c) 求 (a) 中展開式的 \(x^{2}\) 項的係數。
questions.solution:
(a) Expand each product using the distributive law, then collect like terms: \[\begin{gathered}(x^{2}-2 x+1) \\ \cdot (x-1) = x^{3} \\ - 3 x^{2} + 3 x - 1\end{gathered}\]
(b) Degree: \(3\). (c) Coefficient: \(-3\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 用分配律展開每個乘積，再合併同類項：\[\begin{gathered}(x^{2}-2 x+1) \\ \cdot (x-1) = x^{3} \\ - 3 x^{2} + 3 x - 1\end{gathered}\]
(b) 次數：\(3\)。(c) 係數：\(-3\)。

questions.stem:
(a) Expand \[\begin{gathered}(m-2 n) \\ \cdot (m-3+n)\end{gathered}\]
(b) Find the degree of the expansion in (a).
(c) Find the coefficient of \(m n\) in the expansion in (a).
questions.stemZh:
(a) 展開 \[\begin{gathered}(m-2 n) \\ \cdot (m-3+n)\end{gathered}\]
(b) 求 (a) 中展開式的次數。
(c) 求 (a) 中展開式的 \(m n\) 項的係數。
questions.solution:
(a) Expand each product using the distributive law, then collect like terms: \[\begin{gathered}(m-2 n) \\ \cdot (m-3+n) \\ = m^{2} - m n - 3 m \\ - 2 n^{2} + 6 n\end{gathered}\]
(b) Degree: \(2\). (c) Coefficient: \(-1\).

(b) 次數：\(2\)。(c) 係數：\(-1\)。

questions.stem: Simplify \(5^{1-s}\times5^{2-3s}\), where all indices are positive integers.
questions.stemZh: 化簡 \(5^{1-s}\times5^{2-3s}\)，其中所有指數均為正整數。
questions.solution: Add the exponents: \((1-s)+(2-3s)=3-4s\). Therefore the result is \(5^{3-4s}\). The stated exponent conditions are consistent, for example at \(s=0\).
questions.solutionZh: 指數相加：\((1-s)+(2-3s)=3-4s\)，故結果為 \(5^{3-4s}\)。題目的正整數指數條件可成立，例如 \(s=0\)。

questions.stem: If \[\begin{gathered}(a^2b^n)^6 \\ =a^mb^{18}\end{gathered}\], where \(m\) and \(n\) are positive integers, find \(m\) and \(n\).
questions.stemZh: 若 \[\begin{gathered}(a^2b^n)^6 \\ =a^mb^{18}\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(m,n\) 為正整數，求 \(m,n\)。
questions.solution: Compare exponents in \[\begin{gathered}a^{12}b^{6n} \\ =a^mb^{18}\end{gathered}\]: \(m=12\), \(6n=18\), so \(n=3\).
questions.solutionZh: 由 \[\begin{gathered}a^{12}b^{6n} \\ =a^mb^{18}\end{gathered}\] 比較指數：\(m=12\)、\(6n=18\)，所以 \(n=3\)。
